entry_points.text: Compat entry refuses wrong vendors, CPUs lacking virtualization and encrypted-guest hosts, with a migration-safe query and a load-time error check.

Creation reserves host page and MSR bitmap, inits confidential and interrupt state, maps the block and leaves unloaded with reverse cleanup; destruction warns on queued interrupts then releases nested, confidential, block and bitmap; reset clears speculation shadows and rebuilds; load shrinks pause window and loads AVIC; host save is fault-tolerant.

Page faults forward address and code with assisted bytes; misc exits delegate, queue or resume host; CR moves need assist and validity with fallback, writes allow 0/3/4/8 and reads 0/2/3/4/8; CR traps accept 0/4/8; encrypted debug exits return at once, idle ones clear intercepts, others need assist.

VMLOAD/VMSAVE/VMRUN check permissions, map nested blocks, advance and copy by direction; extended invalidation acts as page flush, secure-init faults undefined, page flush uses hardware address when assisted; resume emulates a short image; pause grows spin window; nested hypercalls fault unless a flush assist qualifies.

exports.text: Host toggles for nested paging, extended address mode, virtual GIF, branch sampling, SMI intercept, virtual NMI and VMCB dump default on except dump off, frozen after init and queryable.
Global x86 helpers for invalid-opcode dispatch with forced-emulation check, guest virtual reads, fast port I/O, task switching and buffer emulation.
Shared completion faults or advances past emulated instructions; INVPCID validates then flushes; hypercalls prefer Xen then Hyper-V then a generic path.

hazards.text: A TLB erratum touches config only when the CPU bug is present via fault-tolerant access setting bit 47.
Encrypted-state guests skip shutdown reinit to avoid touching protected state.

invariants.text: Pause filtering uses frozen threshold, window, grow, shrink and max seeds; the window adapts within bounds only on change with dirty mark and trace, idles nested and warns if pause exits are off.

Private switches gate nesting, virtual load/store, TSC scaling and a fault erratum; NPT depth follows build and paging mode; nested TSC offset and multiplier come from nested state with dirty mark on write.

OSVW advertises length at least three hiding host bits with conservative erratum report; host keeps minimum length and union status; per-CPU save pages use encrypted-safe alloc with single free; teardown clears bases; SNP ranges use reverse-map level or smallest granularity.

MSR policy allows direct syscall and base access then tunes branch, speculation, flush, frequency, stack, encryption and perf with PMU mediated; EFER strips virtualization enable; VM_CR locks; LBR maps four slots; PAT splits views; encrypted guests allow only unintercepted indices with host bypass and special injection; AUX updates run preempt-disabled.

INVPCID, RDTSCP and RDPMC stay trapped unless host, guest and paging allow passthrough; VMLOAD/VMSAVE/CLGI/STGI follow SVME and compat; selective CR0 is nested-only; CR8 decreases may exit to userspace; caching supports only PDP reload, others fatal; windows arm dummy vector zero priority 0xf unless AVIC is on; untrapped faults may invert precedence.

VMCB init installs default traps plus conditional traps; it programs bitmaps, segments, tables, NPT tweaks, encryption, AVIC and Hyper-V help, resets ASIDs, refreshes intercepts, marks dirty and enables GIF; control holds bitmaps and interrupt state while save holds segments, tables, CRs and paging; tables exchange base and limit; CR0/CR4 accept; CR3 write-through is encrypted-only; initial CS is selector 0xf000 base 0xffff0000 limit 0xffff, tables base zero limit 0xffff.

Segments preserve base, limit and selector with blended attributes and stack privilege mirror; breakpoints follow guest-debug use; debug status commits on change and control always; NMI restore respects guest single-step; shadow reports combined blocking; delivery programs vector, type and code; opcode checks accept short forms with distinct final bytes for run/load/save; virtual reads walk page by page with fault and I/O suspension.

locks.text: OSVW updates serialize under a spinlock keeping minimum length and union status; VMCB dumps serialize under a mutex.

state_machines.text: Software injection saves base and pointers, restores RIP when next-RIP tracking exists and programs resume only then, dropping on failure; NMI single-step hides trap/resume on read unless guest-set, forces both on write, privilege riding stack reload.

CPU enable takes a reference, refreshes ASID generation, derives bounds, points firmware save per CPU, resets scaling and refreshes workarounds and perf; disable restores and releases; emergency clears only firmware pointer; ASIDs increase per CPU with wrap and flush request.

A per-vCPU loaded marker runs host-save, timing and mitigation setup once per residency and clears on return; entry unmaps GHCB, saves host state fault-tolerantly, prepares encrypted state, writes TSC multiplier when scaling and installs AUX unless virtualized.

A global guest count aids branch mitigation with serialized first-create and last-destroy under a spinlock, broadcast clear on last destroy with recheck, lazy per-CPU set on entry and empty ops when off.

Debug sync forbids encrypted guests, else captures breakpoints, mirrors status and control and refreshes intercepts; debug exits report status, control, linear PC and vector or reinject with saved payload, short traps advance first; machine-check terminates on erratum match else calls host handling; protection exits without error decode virtualization ops or may emulate a backdoor.

STGI/CLGI share checks differing only in flag; IRET excludes encrypted guests, arms completion, captures return and requests events; task switches derive selector and reason, failing with internal error when enforcement is on or MMIO is needed; shutdown reports and resets non-encrypted state; port I/O decodes string, direction, port and size with special or generic paths and fast or parked handling.

INVPCID single forms validate before invalidating, all-context forms request guest-wide flush, unknown types fault; bus-lock exits park with flag, recorded RIP and completion, arming one-step bypass when userspace leaves RIP unchanged else resuming at the new address with nested memory.

structs.text: Per-CPU state holds TSC-ratio cache and SVM area with I/O bitmap base and short resume bytes; CPU match accepts any SVM CPU; fresh segments start zero base and full limit.
CS/SS/DS/ES read current images, FS/GS/TR/LDTR primary; output decodes type, privilege, presence and size with busy and accessed fixes; unknown selectors are fatal.
ABI: LDT type two, busy 16-bit TSS three; soft-vector emulation keeps low eight bits at bit sixteen.
ABI: CR intercept validity is top bit of first info word; CR tracing uses zero for reads and one for writes.
